title: Chapter 564
text:
The difference between Grade B and Grade A was in the level of life. After entering Grade A, one's genes would be more perfect, and the body would be more adapted to the release of energy. The energy consumption during the release process would be greatly reduced, and the output conversion rate would increase significantly. In other words, it was an increase in endurance and attack power. This was why Grade A was praised as' Calamity '.

As the name implied, as long as one released their power, Grade A would be able to cause catastrophic damage to the surface of a planet for a certain period of time. Before the appearance of Beyond Grade A in the exploration era, Grade A was the strongest in the galaxy.

Even now, Grade A was still a huge dividing line.

In his previous life, the highest level limit for players was only Grade A. Therefore, Han Xiao was very clear that once he crossed the threshold of Grade A, his strength would increase by leaps and bounds.

This was a new stage for the ship!

He was now at level 136, and his main class was at level 11. He suppressed his excitement and invested his experience in leveling up.

[Virtual Mechanic] leveled up to Lv.15. + 150 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 3 END, + 6 INT. You have received 6 Free Attribute Points. You have received 1 Potential Point.]

[Your total level has reached 140. You can continue to level up after completing the Promotion Mission.]

At this level, the Promotion Mission would not be easy. Han Xiao only needed one look to know that it was impossible to complete it in a short time. Without hesitation, he used the last Mission Completion Card left from the previous Random Reward. The option of the Promotion Mission instantly turned from gray to gold.

This was the fastest Han Technician had ever completed a Promotion Mission.

There was only one word to describe it — awesome!

[Level 140 Promotion Mission completed! Endurance bonus increased! 1 Endurance = 80 Health = 90 Stamina]

"The last time I did the Promotion at level 120, the Endurance bonus increased from + 10 to + 15, reaching 1: 65. Now that I'm at level 140, it's also + 15 to 1: 80. After this Race Evolution, the Endurance bonus will increase to + 20 in the next Promotion."

Han Xiao thought to himself.

From level 60 onwards, every 40 levels would be a Race Evolution. Level 140 would be the third Race Evolution!

Notifications popped up on the interface like flowing water.

[After a long time of coexisting with Energy, your genes have been optimized again. You have gone one step further on the path of evolution. You have obtained a sublimation in the level of life. Detected race: [Void Prowler (Human Form)] … Randomly drawing seven compatible evolution paths … Drawing complete.]

[Please choose one of the seven options below as your evolved race. Warning! The evolution process is irreversible. Please choose carefully! [Appendix — Evolution Path Characteristics]

[V-type Space Human] -74% Compatibility]

[Void Symbiotic Body (Human Form)] -88% Compatibility]

[Void Corruptor (Human Form)] -75% Compatibility]

[Void Hunter (Human Form)] -77% Compatibility]

[Chaos Observer (Human Form)] -72% Compatibility]

[Eye Void Eye] -42% Compatibility

[High Energy Entity (Soul-based Creature)] -35% Compatibility]

Out of the seven options, five of them belonged to the Void Evolution System.

The Void System was a rare evolution chain that was very difficult to obtain. Normal Race Evolution only had a very small probability of randomly drawing out the Void System's evolution path. Han Xiao had consumed the Void Dragon's bone marrow and obtained a part of the Void Gene fragment. The [Void Prowler] only appeared in the last Race Evolution.

After becoming the [Void Prowler], his evolution chain had deviated from the human race's main branch to the Void System's branch. At the same time, he retained part of the human race's characteristics. The Void System was a kind of mutated evolution and had a high degree of integration with different species. Therefore, many evolution options were labeled with the characteristics of "human form".

Of course, there were also options that did not retain the human form. For example, [Eye Void] would become a large eyeball with tentacles. It had the Fear Judgement of the Void Gaze. Whoever it stared at would have a miscarriage.

[High Energy Entity] was another form of energy life. Soul-based creatures were similar to Liches. As long as their soul core was not damaged, even if their energy body was destroyed, they could be repaired at any time. This was a species suitable for Mages.

Han Xiao naturally wanted to retain the Void System's evolution path, which had great potential. At the same time, he also needed a human body to complete mechanical construction. Some of his talents could only continue to take effect in human form. Therefore, only four Void Evolution options that retained the human form met the requirements.

"I now have extremely high tankiness, so I don't need to worry about health. What I lack is attack power. I'm a Mechanic, so the higher my Intelligence, the higher the bonus …"

After thinking for a while, Han Xiaoxin made a decision and seriously confirmed the evolution path.

[Selection complete. Evolving … Evolution complete.]

[Race changed to [Chaos Observer (Human Form)]. Molecular structure improved, organ structure strengthened, metabolism changed, adaptability increased … Your potential has increased!]

[You have received attributes: STR + 0, DEX + 40, END + 15, INT + 94, MYS + 72, CHA + 56, Energy + 840. Energy Level bonus attributes have changed!]

An avalanche of pain exploded from the depths of his body. Han Xiao was already mentally prepared. He gritted his teeth and endured the pain that was enough to make an ordinary person faint. He tried his best to feel the changes in his cells and genes.

His body uncontrollably turned into a Void Creature, and his vision kept flickering between the physical world and the Void Dimension. It was as if there were dozens of frames per second. This time, the pain in his brain was the most intense. It was as if thousands of needles had pierced into his brain.

[Chaos Observer]'s attributes were more inclined toward Intelligence. This was one of the reasons why he chose this path. Another reason was that Han Xiao still remembered that this path had a chance of evolving into a high-level Void Creature. Its potential was greater than the other three options.

Fortunately, the pain this time was not as painful as when he evolved into [Void Prowler]. Han Xiao was already a Void Creature, so the changes in his genes were not that intense.

"Huff — Huff —"

After a long time, the pain slowly subsided. Han Xiao was panting heavily and sweating all over. It was as if he had just been fished out of the water. The world in his eyes became clearer and clearer. His brain was working faster, and all kinds of thoughts appeared one after another like bubbles in boiling water.

Han Xiao felt for a few seconds and looked at the interface to check his new race talent.

[Your race's characteristics have changed!]

[You have received race's characteristic [Advanced Void Travel]!]

[You have received race's characteristic [Void Vision — Observer]!]

[You have received race's characteristic [Observer's Mark]!]

[You have received race's characteristic [Chaos Form – Release]!]

"Four talents!" Han Xiao's face was filled with joy. This was one more than the Void Prowler.

He tried them one by one and had an idea.

Among them, the one he was most familiar with was [Advanced Void Travel]. This was the advanced version of [Void Travel], and its duration was longer. As long as he was willing, he could maintain it for up to three minutes. The duration had increased by a few times, which meant that he could 'blink' further and complete more things. The cooldown time was still five minutes.

As for the other three talents, they were the special abilities of [Chaos Observer]. Among them, [Chaos Form – Release] was the core. The other two talents could only be used after [Chaos Form – Release] was activated.

With a thought, Han Xiao suddenly dispersed and turned into a gray fog. This was a strange energy field. Light would be swallowed by the gray fog, but it still maintained its original gray color and did not turn black. It was very strange.

It was like using space as a canvas and a gray paint was smeared on it.

His own senses also changed. He no longer used his' eyes' to see and 'ears' to hear. This chaotic fog had vision, hearing, touch, smell, and other senses at the same time. Moreover, they were many times sharper. When he moved, he no longer had the control of his body like a human. Instead, with the gray fog as the core, he moved around and could constantly change his shape. It was like a cloud that could move on its own. Its speed was also very fast. It also had the ability to pass through walls like Void Travel. It was very magical.

Not only that, there were also new senses that were hard to describe and indescribable.

"This is the Chaos Form?"

Han Xiao thought to himself. He suddenly realized how he could think without a brain. After thinking for a long time, he roughly understood that after becoming a 'Chaos Form', he had changed from a physical life form to a domain life form. This chaotic fog formed countless organ structures on a microscopic level. Molecular and atomic structures formed a thinking circuit, and bioelectricity flowed within.

He could create artificial intelligence, so it was not strange for him to have a new form of thinking organ.

He tried out the other two talents. [Void Vision – Observer] allowed him to enter the gap between the Void Dimension and the physical world in the form of a Chaos Form. It was not like [Void Travel] where time was almost frozen. When he used this ability, the time in the outside world would flow normally, and he could hide in the gap to observe the changes in the outside world. His vision was very wide.

[Observer's Mark] was related to a new sense. As long as a mark was set on a certain person, a certain place, or a certain spatial coordinate, he could observe across space simultaneously. It was like a split screen mode. The number of marks could be changed at most five.

"Wait … What kind of observation is this? This is obviously peeping!"

Han Xiaoxin's feelings were indescribable.

I have become an eye position?!

This is getting more and more 'perverted' — I like it!

After transforming into a Chaos Form, the attribute panel also changed. It showed the status of 'after transformation'. He was immune to 95% damage, and the energy value of his human form became the HP of his Chaos Form. This meant that he was using energy to maintain his Chaos Form. Most of the skills and talents of his human form were frozen, but [Advanced Void Travel] would be greatly strengthened, and the cooldown time would be reduced from 5 minutes to 15 seconds.

If the HP of his Chaos Form was depleted, he would be forced to return to his human form. His energy value would be reduced to zero, and there would be a negative status of [Heavy Injury]. At the same time, [Chaos Form – Release] would enter a 48-hour cooldown period.

"In other words, the Chaos Form does not have much combat power. It is mainly used to observe and run. This is a support function."

After deactivating the [Chaos Form – Release] transformation, the gray fog rolled and shrunk, condensing into a human form in the Void Dimension. Then, his skin returned to its normal color, and he returned to his original human form.

Han Xiao took out a mirror and looked at himself. This time, it was not an illusion. He seemed to have become more handsome and taller. His eyes were especially beautiful, and he had the urge to dig them out and collect them.

These were the changes of his Race Evolution. There were more notifications on the panel:

[Your combat power has exceeded 10000 Ona!]

[You have leveled up to Grade A!]

[You have received a special Grade Bonus!]

A special Grade Bonus was an additional increase that would only appear when one reached Grade A. With 10000 Ona as the standard, every increase of 10000 Energy Levels would give a new Grade Bonus. The difference between Grade A and 'Beyond Grade A' was very large.

There was a difference in strength between Grade A and Grade A. The simplest way was to compare their combat power or distinguish the difference in level, attributes, skills, and talents. A Grade A + powerhouse could even crush an ordinary Grade A Calamity who had just entered Grade A.

[Your END bonus + 10. Currently: 1 END = 90 HP = 100 Stamina.]

[All Resistances + 8%!]

[Highest Attribute + 10%. Other Attributes + 5%]

[You have received an additional 30 Free Attribute Points.]

[You have received an additional 5 Potential Points.]

[You have learned the ability [Mechanical Force Field].]

[You have received the Grade Talent [Superhuman].]

These two were exclusive abilities that could only be learned when one reached Grade A. Among them, the Grade Talent [Superhuman] was fixed, and the abilities would change according to one's class. Han Xiao had played many different classes in the past, so he was very clear about this.

[Mechanical Force Field]: When you apply Mechanical Force, a Mechanical Force Field will be formed around a certain area with a machine as the center point. The machines in this area will receive a random 40% -80% bonus effect (non-stackable). Only the energy of one machine will be consumed. The range of the field depends on the Intelligence attribute.]

This ability was a practical ability of the Mechanic class, and it was the core ability of the Army Style. As long as one machine was strengthened, the consumption would not change, but the surrounding machines would share the effect, increasing the user's stamina. In the players' terms, this was called 'Splash Bonus'.

[Superhuman]: You have learned how to perfectly control your own abilities. Ability strength increased (including but not limited to various weapons and equipment, machinery created with Mechanical Force, summoned creatures, and other combat methods controlled by yourself). Bonus effect depends on the total level of the character. Level 1 – Level 100, + 2% Attack every 10 levels; Level 100 – Level 160, + 3% Attack every 10 levels; Level 160 and above, + 4% Attack every 10 levels.]

[Current Ability Strength Increase: 32%]

The previous ability was to increase one's stamina, and [Superhuman] was the main reason why Calamity Grade Supers had such a huge increase in their destructive power. Ability strength was basically equivalent to attack power.

This bonus was independent of all talents and skills, which meant that no matter how high one's attack power was, it would be increased by a percentage based on this.

The stronger the attack, the greater the increase.

The higher the level, the greater the increase.

For example, Ames' terrifying attack power was due to this talent. Of course, the main reason was because Floating Dragon Island was tough enough.

All the notifications ended there. Han Xiao used his remaining experience to max out [Mechanical Force Field], then leveled it up two more times and threw all his Free Attribute Points into Intelligence.

After reaching level 140, the consumption of leveling up became even greater. Just two levels had cost him close to two billion experience. If he were to use the mission rewards of Version 2.0 as the standard, it would take ages for him to level up.

In his previous life, the mission rewards of the players increased with the version. At this level, the experience reward would easily start from tens of millions.

"I've finally reached the Calamity Grade!"

Filled with surging energy, Han Xiao had an excited expression on his face. He clenched his fists and felt as though he could kill a Harmon with a single punch.

He looked at his attribute interface and checked the overall changes.

[Total Level: 142]

[Main Class: Mechanic]

[Race: Chaos Observer (Human Form)]

[Strength: 201, DEX: 518, END: 485, INT: 1,500, MYS: 220, CHA: 102, LUK: 1]

[Free Attribute Points: 0]

[Potential Points: 62]

[Health: 64020]

[Stamina: 64520]

[Energy: 12410 (LV10)]

[LV10 Energy Bonus: + 81 STR, + 113 DEX, + 122 END, + 144 INT, + 91 MYS, + 16020 Stamina Limit, + 97% Machinery Affinity]

[Energy Rank: 11237 Ona]

[Grade: A]

[Grade A Bonuses: + 10 END, + 8% All Resistances, + 10% Highest Attribute, + 5% Other Attributes, + 30 Free Attribute Points, + 5 Potential Points]
